description: This file implements a cached discovery client for Kubernetes API server discovery, managing cache files on disk, cache invalidation, and integration with OpenAPI schemas.

classes.name: CachedDiscoveryClient
classes.description: A client that caches discovery information from the Kubernetes API server on disk, supporting cache invalidation and refresh.

methods.name: ServerResourcesForGroupVersion
methods.description: Returns supported resources for a specific API group and version, using cached data if available.

methods.name: ServerGroupsAndResources
methods.description: Returns all supported API groups and resources.

methods.name: ServerGroups
methods.description: Returns supported API groups with version info, using cache if available.

methods.name: getCachedFile
methods.description: Reads a cache file if valid and not invalidated.

methods.name: writeCachedFile
methods.description: Writes an object to cache file atomically.

methods.name: RESTClient
methods.description: Returns the REST client used for API communication.

methods.name: ServerPreferredResources
methods.description: Returns resources with server's preferred versions.

methods.name: ServerPreferredNamespacedResources
methods.description: Returns namespaced resources with server's preferred versions.

methods.name: OpenAPIV3
methods.description: Retrieves OpenAPI v3 specs, with caching.

methods.name: Fresh
methods.description: Indicates if cache is fresh and can be trusted.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates cache, forcing refresh on next use.

methods.name: WithLegacy
methods.description: Returns current client, does not support legacy-only discovery.

methods.name: NewCachedDiscoveryClientForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new cached discovery client with configuration and cache directories.

methods.name: newCachedDiscoveryClient
methods.description: Helper to instantiate a CachedDiscoveryClient with delegate, cache directory, and TTL.
